label: Updated at 12 p.m. ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Tiger's First Return
items.text: Tiger Woods is expected to make his first on-course appearance since his March DUI arrest at the NEXUS Cup charity event Monday and Tuesday at Liberty National, following his plea change to no contest and the DUI reduced to reckless driving.

items.headline: McIlroy Trails Niemann
items.text: Joaquin Niemann leads the wind-blown Irish Open after shooting 65 with four consecutive late birdies, while Rory McIlroy sits four shots back after a 69 in tough conditions, facing a crucial second round.

items.headline: Trump to Attend 2027 Ryder Cup
items.text: Donald Trump confirmed he will attend the 2027 Ryder Cup at Adare Manor in Ireland despite expected protests, raising security concerns ahead of golf's major team event returning to Ireland for the first time since 2006.
